title: stenostomum turrialbanum
intro: Stenostomum turrialbanum, commonly known as "Costa Rican firecracker", is a plant species in the Acanthaceae family, native to Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stenostomum turrialbanum include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antiseptic properties, making it a potential remedy for wounds and infections. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
